items.textToSpeech: Selenium contributes to: normal spermatogenesis, the maintenance of normal hair, the maintenance of normal nails, the normal function of the immune system, normal thyroid function, and the protection of cells from oxidative stress.

The European Commission has authorised these claims for products which contain at least 8.25 micrograms of selenium per 100 grams, per 100 millilitres or per package, if the package contains only a single portion. Is there anything else I can help you with?
